subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should core OpenClaw-tools MCP and Codex-owned supervision expose a stable shared fatal-diagnostic contract, or should their formatting remain owner-local?
rationale: The proposed extraction crosses an intentional core/plugin ownership boundary, and source similarity alone does not establish that identical output is a supported product contract.

options.title: Keep owner-local formatting
options.body: Retain separate renderers and only remove duplication within each owner until a concrete cross-pipeline consumer requires consistency.

options.title: Define a structured contract
options.body: Approve a generic diagnostic shape through a public owner-safe seam, with each pipeline rendering that shape without importing core internals.

recommendation.title: Keep owner-local formatting
recommendation.body: Retain separate renderers and only remove duplication within each owner until a concrete cross-pipeline consumer requires consistency.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant ownership boundary appears to date to the Codex harness refactor they introduced and merged.
